question: Read the three maps in Figure 1.7. Which years do they compare, what does the shared color scale measure, and does the dark high-poverty area generally expand or contract?
answer:
The three maps in Figure 1.7 compare the years 2009, 2015, and 2019. [p052-figure-1.7]

The shared color scale measures the poverty rate (%). [p052-figure-1.7]

The dark high-poverty area generally contracts over the years. [p052-figure-1.7]
